 中國經濟已由中央計劃經濟轉型為在更大程度                  The PRC’s economy has been transitioning from a centrally planned
 上以市場為導向的經濟。近30 年來，中國政府                economy to a more market oriented economy. For approximately three
 已實施經濟改革措施，運用市場力量發展中國                  decades, the PRC government has implemented economic reform
 經濟。本集團無法預測中國經濟、政治及社會                  measures to utilize market forces in the development of the PRC’s
 狀況以及法律法規及政策的變動是否會對本集                  economy. The Group cannot predict whether changes in the PRC’s
 團當前或未來的業務、財務狀況或經營業績造                  economic, political and social conditions and in its laws, regulations
 成任何不利影響。此外，中國政府進行的多項                  and policies will have any adverse effect on the Group’s current or
 經濟改革乃史無前例或屬實驗性質，預期將隨                  future business, financial condition or results of operations. In addition,
 時間的推進而不斷改進及完善。此種改進及調                  many of the economic reforms carried out by the PRC government
 整未必會對本集團的運營及業務發展帶來正面                  are unprecedented or experimental and are expected to be refined
 影響。                                   and improved over time. This refining and adjustment process may
                                       not necessarily have a positive effect on the Group’s operations and
                                       business development.

  的任何變動，對風險進行匯總、評級並記錄緩                      material internal control defects (if any), including any changes relevant

2.23 撥備及或然負債                                      2.23 Provisions and contingent liabilities
       倘本集團因過往事件而現時須承擔法定                                Provisions are recognised when: the Group has a present legal or
       或推定責任，且履行該等責任可能須流                                constructive obligation as a result of past events; it is more likely
       出資源，及所涉及的金額能可靠估計                                 than not that an outflow of resources will be required to settle
       時，則確認撥備。未來營運虧損毋須確                                the obligation; and the amount has been reliably estimated.
       認撥備。                                             Provisions are not recognised for future operating losses.


       倘存在多項相若責任時，履行該等責任                                Where there are a number of similar obligations, the likelihood
       是否需要流出資源在考慮整體責任之類                                that an outflow will be required in settlement is determined by
       別後釐定。即使同一類別之任何一項責                                considering the class of obligations as a whole. A provision is
       任可能須資源流出的可能性極低，亦須                                recognised even if the likelihood of an outflow with respect to
       確認撥備。                                            any one item included in the same class of obligations may be
                                                        small.


       撥備按管理層對於報告期末對須償付現                                Provisions are measured at the present value of management’s
       有責任的最佳估計支出的現值計量。用                                best estimate of the expenditure required to settle the present
       於釐定現值的貼現率為反映當時市場對                                obligation at the end of the reporting period. The discount rate
       金錢時間值及負債特定風險的評估的稅                                used to determine the present value is a pre-tax rate that reflects
       前利率。隨時間增加的撥備確認為利息                                current market assessments of the time value of money and the
       開支。                                              risks specific to the liability. The increase in the provision due to
                                                        the passage of time is recognised as interest expense.


       或然負債乃一項因過往事件可能產生的                                A contingent liability is a possible obligation that arises from
       責任，而該責任的存在僅可由一項或多                                past events and whose existence will only be confirmed by the
       項並非由本集團全權控制之日後不明朗                                occurrence or non-occurrence of one or more uncertain future
       事件之存在與否確定。或然負債亦可為                                events not wholly within the control of the Group. It can also
       因不大可能需要經濟資源流出或承擔之                                be a present obligation arising from past events that is not
       金額未能可靠地估量而未確認之過往事                                recognised because it is not probable that outflow of economic
       件產生之現有承擔。                                        resources will be required or the amount of obligation cannot be
                                                        measured reliably.


       或然負債不予確認，但會於合併財務報                                A contingent liability is not recognised but is disclosed in the
       表附註中披露。倘流出之可能性出現變                                notes to the consolidated financial statements. When a change
       動致使有可能流出，則將其確認為撥備。                               in the probability of an outflow occurs so that outflow is
                                                        probable, it will then be recognised as a provision.

           併財務狀況表所列示的權益總額加上債                                   equity, as shown in the consolidated statement of financial
